notes.title: Release date is set!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29645849/50ec3456323801d32c6c22c62a2443c625e0265a.png[/img]
[h1]Releases on [b]November 30th, 2017![/b][/h1]

It took us a little under forever to complete, but we've finally done it!
A huge THANKS to all our beta testers who've helped a lot with polishing the game to high gloss. Join us now in our anticipation and get ready for [i]THE[/i] shoot ‘em up you were looking for!
In addition to the features listed on our store page, we've got a healthy amount of trading cards, emoticons and beautiful profile backgrounds just waiting to be approved shortly after the game's release.
We're hoping all your patience will be handsomely rewarded in just a few more weeks, when the game gets released to the public!
